tasks.short: Supervise a field survey for a revision.

steps.what: Open the construction drawings that may need revision.
Supervise or conduct the field survey and the inspection.
File the data required to revise the drawings.

tasks.design: The construction drawings are opened from {DOCS} before anyone goes out. The drafter supervises or conducts the field survey, inspection, or technical investigation. Data is filed only from that work. The pack does not revise the drawing. A survey with no observation is not a revision.
tasks.previous_blocker: The reason for the revision was a phone call, and the field notes were transcribed days later.
tasks.enabler_now: The drawings in question can be one pack. The survey is unchanged.
tasks.still_hard: Access to the site, weather, and an investigation that finds a different problem.
tasks.human_edge: The drafter can see that the drawing is wrong for a reason the pack did not name.
tasks.altitude: The pack can be ready. The field survey stays on site with the drafter. No drawing is revised from the desk.

reach.task: Conduct the survey the revision depends on.
reach.learn: The pack can name the sheet. The survey cannot be skipped.

evidence.claim: A drawing pack can be opened before a survey. It cannot conduct the survey.
Revision data comes from the field. EU GDPR article 22 is not met by revising a drawing from a desk with no observation.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An architectural or civil drafter in a European practice. National building rules apply. A list does not issue a drawing.
Fields: Sheet id, produced by the drawing set. An empty reason does not create a survey. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the drafter finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the drawing set the practice already keeps. No new tool replaces the visit.
unknowns: Which sites need permission to enter.
research_questions: What share of revisions start with a written reason?
Which inspections cannot be done from a photo?

already_counted.description: The drafter still conducts the survey.
The drafter still files the data.

incremental.description: The drafter writes the reason when the pack has none.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is opening the drawings. It disappears when the reason is unwritten and the drafter prepares on site. The survey time is unchanged, which matches a prior that this stays manual.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Open the procedure the session will use.
Supervise and train the other drafters and technicians.
Record attendance without a skill score.

tasks.design: The signed procedure is opened from {DOCS}. The drafter supervises and trains the other technologists, technicians, and drafters. Attendance may be stored in the {LMS} only with works-council consent, and it stores no skill score. The screen does not assign work by how someone draws.
tasks.previous_blocker: Training used a personal copy of the procedure, and who attended was remembered.
tasks.enabler_now: The signed procedure can be the pack. The teaching is unchanged.
tasks.still_hard: A question the procedure does not answer, and a person who needs supervision beyond the session.
tasks.human_edge: The drafter can tell attendance from competence.
tasks.altitude: The procedure is the current one. Supervision and training stay with the drafter. Nobody is scored.

reach.task: Learn a procedure from a person and keep competence as a judgement.
reach.learn: The pack can be the signed procedure. The training cannot be a score.

evidence.claim: An attendance list can record who was in the room. It cannot score a drafter.
EU AI Act Annex III 4(b) and works-council consent cover assigning work by performance. This task stores no skill score.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An architectural or civil drafter in a European practice. National building rules apply. A list does not issue a drawing.

Fields: Procedure version and session id, produced by the procedure file. A session with no version is not opened from the register. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the drafter finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the learning record only if consent covers attendance. No extra score field. No new tool ranks people.
unknowns: Whether consent for attendance already exists.
Who is in scope to be trained.
research_questions: Which skills are judged only by watching the work?

incremental.description: The drafter updates the pack when the procedure changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is opening the signed procedure. It disappears when consent for a list is refused and the drafter keeps paper. The training time is unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Open the topographical surveys and the well logs.
Correlate and interpret the surveys and the geophysical reports.
Modify the data only where the drafter has interpreted it.

tasks.design: Topographical surveys, well logs, and geophysical reports already filed are opened from {DOCS}. The drafter correlates and interprets them and modifies data only as that interpretation allows. The pack does not interpret a formation. A file with no survey is not modified.
tasks.previous_blocker: Logs and surveys sat in different folders, and the interpretation was a markup on a paper copy.
tasks.enabler_now: Filed surveys and logs can be one pack before the reading.
tasks.still_hard: A log that disagrees with the survey, and a formation the drafter must not decide alone.
tasks.human_edge: The drafter can see two files that overlap and still describe different ground.
tasks.altitude: The pack is together. Interpretation and any modification stay with the drafter. No formation is decided by the screen.

reach.task: Produce the survey the interpretation starts from.
reach.learn: The files can be opened together. The interpretation cannot.

evidence.claim: Surveys and logs can be opened as one pack. They cannot be interpreted by the pack.

A map or a symbol reading does not decide a permit or a tax. EU GDPR article 22 bars a solely automated decision with a legal effect. Modifying a subsurface reading is the drafter's act, and the engineer still owns the geotechnical conclusion.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An architectural or civil drafter in a European practice. National building rules apply. A list does not issue a drawing.
Fields: Survey id and log id, produced by the project file. A set with no survey id is not modified. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the drafter finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the files the practice already keeps.
unknowns: Which logs are in a coordinate system the survey shares.
research_questions: Are logs filed against the survey?
What share of modifications are later reversed?

already_counted.description: The drafter still modifies the data.

incremental.description: The drafter fetches a log the pack missed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is opening the pack. It disappears when a log is missing and the drafter hunts it. Interpretation remains, so the net stays under the prior.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Open the sketches and notes for the civil job.
Draft plans for highways, sewage systems, and other structures.
Check the plans against the notes.

tasks.design: Sketches and notes are opened from {DOCS}. The drafter drafts the plans and detailed drawings for structures, installations, and construction projects such as highways, sewage disposal systems, and dikes, on the drawing model in {OTHER}. The notes do not draft the plan. A safety component is not put into service by this drawing.
tasks.previous_blocker: Notes for a highway or a dike were a marked-up print, easy to mix with the last job.
tasks.enabler_now: The notes can be one pack. The drafting is unchanged.
tasks.still_hard: A note that contradicts the sketch, and a structure the drafter must not size alone.
tasks.human_edge: The drafter can see notes that are complete and a plan that would mislead the site.
tasks.altitude: The notes are together. The civil plans are still drafted by the drafter. Nothing is certified.

reach.task: Provide the notes for a highway plan the drafter drafts.
reach.learn: The pack can be opened. The plan is still drafted here.

evidence.claim: A note pack can be opened. It cannot draft a highway, sewage, or dike plan.
The drawing stays with the drafter. EU AI Act Annex III point 2 on safety components is not met by storing a plan, and this task does not place a safety function into service.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An architectural or civil drafter in a European practice. National building rules apply. A list does not issue a drawing.
Fields: Note id and sketch id, produced by the project file. A plan with no note id is not marked drafted. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the drafter finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the project file the practice already keeps.
unknowns: Which structures the engineer must size.
Whether the job is a dike, a road, or a sewer.
research_questions: Are engineer notes filed against the sheet?
What share of plans are redrawn after the first check?

already_counted.description: The drafter still drafts the plans.
The drafter still checks the notes.

incremental.description: The drafter fetches a note the pack missed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is the note pack. It disappears when the notes are on paper only and the drafter sorts them. The drafting time is unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Field surveys, training, and civil drawings stay with the drafter. Survey tables can be opened. No one is scored for how they draw.
reach: Surveying and mapping technicians run the field survey, and this job learns the drawing is revised only after the data is in.
Civil engineers direct a highway or a dike drawing, and this job learns the plan is still drafted.
skills_to_grow: Keep a survey revision waiting on data the drafter or the surveyor actually obtained.
Train another drafter without storing a skill score.
role.ambitious_version: A field survey still happens on the ground, and a civil plan is still drafted from the sketch the engineer gave.
